watches.name: Watch NC 003 FLUIDE
watches.description: Despite the slight resistance of the fluid on the hands, this in no way impairs timekeeping, as the electronic circuit is set with an advance of 0.2 seconds per day to balance the rate. The air bubble: A bubble of + or – 5 mm is present in the fluid. Its role is to balance the watch’s internal pressure. It can be either visible under the glass, or invisible as it is hidden behind the dial. Its size varies according to its environment. Temperature : When cold, the fluid shrinks and the volume of the air bubble expands. Under the effect of heat, the volume of the fluid expands, compressing the bubble and causing it to shrink. Pressure: Under high pressure (diving), the bubble is compressed and decreases in size. Conversely, at low pressure (high mountains), its size increases. A 39mm case in brushed 316L steel, a uni-directional rotating bezel rotating bezel in black PVD steel makes this dive watch a a perfect perfect “Tool Watch” water-resistant to 1000m. Fluid Version Staying true to its philosophy, Horloscaphe draws inspiration from scuba diving instruments for the fluid version of the NC003 model. Like pressure gauges, diving compasses, and glycerin-filled depth gauges, Horloscaphe applies this principle: encapsulating a non-silicone, dielectric fluid with a density higher than water, for these numerous advantages: – Greatly increasing its resistance to hydrostatic pressure, – Lubricating the internal components and extending the life of the movement, – Enabling better readability because the internal fluid reduces glare,

watches.name: NC003 AUTOMATIC WATCH SPECIAL DIATOME SERIES
watches.description: Diatomée is a large sailboat that travels from the poles to the tropics, with the aim of raising awareness of the marine environment through the intersecting views of scientists, children, athletes and artists who will come along on its expeditions. The idea is to invite personalities with a particular attachment to water, to create a collective to develop projects rich in challenges, learning and artistic creations. They pool their knowledge in the fields they love (sailing, freediving, animals, image production), to mount expeditions, reports, their way of seeing the world, in the quietest and craziest corners of the planet. They also collaborate with schools, which follow their adventures and discover with us the riches of the oceans to better protect them. Part of the proceeds will be donated to the association. www.laroutesalee.com The Diatomée project: The project was born during a presentation of my watches to Alex VOYER, captain of the sailboat Diatomée, three years ago. As we lived just a few kilometers from each other on the banks of the Canal de l’Ourcq, we met. Alex, who is passionate about watchmaking, especially diving watches, discussed the matter at length, and the alchemy of watchmaking worked between the “tocantes toqués”, and the project was born.
